items.title: Bitcoin Rises on Cooler-Than-Expected Inflation Data
items.summary: Bitcoin added 1.4% over the last 24 hours to $85,380 on Tuesday, according to CoinDesk.  The cryptocurrency is down 2.5% this year, but is up 45% this quarter, pacing its best quarterly performance since 2024, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  The personal consumption expenditures, or PCE, price index reached 3.4% year over year in August, below consensus projections to remain at 3.7%.
